item.title: Re: A Plushie Friend
item.content:encoded:
Hello!

SCP-#### would be brought home by the field agent, who, when, in tears, hugged the object, would hear a voice calming him down.

Why would the Foundation let him take it home? They never let people keep anomalies.

He would later survive a stray bullet with no damage at all while he slept, hugging the plushie. After that, the field agent would bring the object to the foundation site immediately.

Where does the stray bullet come from.

against some Groups of Interest, who would want to have SCP-#### so they could become invincible.

I don't think you need to include any GOIs, what you have so far looks good enough.

SCP-#### would be discovered by a field agent accidentally, when a little boy hugging the object was run over by a truck and suffered no damage at all. He (the field agent) would keep an eye on the boy for some months, who seemed to have no anomalous properties.

Sounds like a fun idea, try to hide the fact that the plushie is the anomaly at first then reveal it later on, you might need to include multiple iterations of the SCP.

Honestly, I'm liking this. I'm a huge fan of friendly SCPs and this seems to be a really good idea to include some really emotional bits if you write it well.

I'm gonna Greenlight this. There is room for expansion, but it still feels like a cool idea. I like how simple it is, I see a lot of new writers try to use overly complicated ideas before their ready so this looks like a really good place to start for a first time author.

Good luck!

Also, remember you do not need a second Greenlight in order to ask for help on the #thecritters channel.

item.title: A Plushie Friend
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Fiction (as always)

Page Layout (Optional): Basic Article Template, interviews only with tests subjects, normal test logs.

+ Elevator Pitch
- Elevator Pitch

Elevator Pitch: What started out as an idea of an anomalous plushie that would do good things became… well, a Thaumiel-Class anomalous old monkey plushie with a simple backstory that protects (physically and emotionally) the ones hugging it if they are emotionally linked to the object.

+ Central Narrative
- Central Narrative

Central Narrative: SCP-#### would be discovered by a field agent accidentally, when a little boy hugging the object was run over by a truck and suffered no damage at all. He (the field agent) would keep an eye on the boy for some months, who seemed to have no anomalous properties. The field agent would become a friend of the boy and his plushie. Months later, the boy would give the plushie to the field agent and make him promise to take care of “him”. He said that he would go to a place called “Imagination” and promised he would send letters to the plushie and to the agent every few weeks. SCP-#### would be brought home by the field agent. After half a year, the boy would be found dead at the roadside. When the field agent, in tears, hugged the object, he would hear a voice calming him down. The man would later survive a stray bullet with no damage at all while he slept hugging the plushie. After that, the field agent would bring the object to the foundation site.

+ Hook/Attention-Grabber
- Hook/Attention-Grabber

Hook/Attention-Grabber: This artifact would be kept in a room safe from external groups of interest, only reliable personnel would come into contact with it and SCP-#### would sometimes ask to the ones hugging him to write letters destined to “Imagination”, saying he moved and was being treated well by the Researchers. It would be an object protected by the Foundation against some Groups of Interest, who would want to have SCP-#### so they could become invincible.

+ Additional Notes
- Additional Notes

Additional Notes: Still needs some proofreading because, as the guide says, “as the author you develop a certain blindness to your own writing.” Also needs lots of criticism and some similar SCPs.
